stem.en: Which new find would help most in deciphering the Sindhu lipi?

text.en: A seal older than any found so far.

feedback.en: An older seal would still be short and still unread. Age does not give scholars anything to check a guess against.

text.en: A clearer, less worn copy of a seal we already have.

feedback.en: The signs we have are already clear enough to see. The difficulty is that nothing shows what they say.

text.en: A stone with the same message in the Sindhu lipi and in a script we can read.
A seal with a larger picture of a bull.

feedback.en: A picture shows what the seal shows, but it gives no sound or word for any sign.

explanation.en: Scholars deciphered other scripts with the help of a text that had a known script beside it. The same message appears twice, so a guess at one can be checked against the other. Nothing of this kind has been found for the Sindhu lipi.

hints.en: What helped scholars read cuneiform and hieroglyphs?
